<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the documentation of org.hortonmachine.modules.RangeLookup: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

The ranges are separated by commas, each with its lower and upper bound separated by a space and enclosed in brackets: a square bracket includes the bound, a round one excludes it, and `null` leaves the range open on that side. The classes, also separated by commas, go to the ranges in the same order. For example `[0 10),[10 20),[20 null)` with `1,2,3` gives 1 to the values from 0 to below 10, 2 from 10 to below 20 and 3 from 20 up. The cells that fall in no range become no-data, and the no-data cells of the input stay no-data, also in a range open downwards.
